Analog Fox browse by type pitch/octave octaver octave fuzz octave fuzz (1 octave up) browse by enclosure pedal Analog Fox Tone Machine Published on September 3, 2017 Analog Fox octave fuzz (1 octave up) pedal Information Analog Fox Tone Machine is a clone of Foxx Tone Machine, which was produced in 70s. The pedal is a thick sounding fuzz with lots of gain and a footswitch that allows adding an upper octave to the sound. The controls are: Sustain Â- sets amount of distortion (sustain)  Tone Â- filters out high or low frequencies  Volume Â- sets the output volume  This circuit was used by artists ranging from ZZ Top to Adrian Belew, Parliament-Funkadelic to Peter Frampton. Its legacy has lived on as a new generation of artists (Nine Inch Nails, Beck) has discovered the fat-backed, fuzzed-out sound that pedal screams. Made in Russia with high quality components.
